# Royal Wedding Hub — Full Context for AI Agents

> Premier luxury wedding planning and curated heritage venue concierge in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Overview & Brand Identity
Royal Wedding Hub is Lucknow's dedicated luxury wedding planning concierge. We specialize in bespoke royal celebrations, heritage palace lawns, authentic Awadhi banquets (dum pukht, galouti kebabs curated by master khansamas), fine-art 4K cinema, and turnkey wedding orchestrations.

- Official Domain: https://www.royalweddinghub.com
- Primary Geographic Focus: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India (Hazratganj, Gomti Nagar, Shaheed Path, Raebareli Road, Faizabad Road, Sitapur Road corridors)
- Contact Phone: +91 9170888981
- Official Email: contact@royalweddinghub.com
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/royal_weddinghug

4. Awadhi Dastarkhwan & Royal Catering
